task: Independent pad and polysynth behavior review
result: No production correction indicated by these focused measurements.
qualification: Development behavior checks from a pinned capture executable. Not final native artifact qualification or a perceptual quality score.

risks_reviewed.risk: Long pad voices might thin out or lose the root after a short audition excerpt, particularly across the register.
risks_reviewed.finding: Evolving, Cathedral and Shimmer Pad retained held energy during seconds 5–9 at both tested keys. Late RMS differs from seconds 3–4 by -0.5905 to +0.0379dB. Root-band energy remains 49.53–89.03% of measured mono spectral energy.
risks_reviewed.method: 48kHz float renders held 10 s, tail 2 s. Opening window 0.05–0.25s, bloom 3–4s, held 5–9s. Root-band energy uses a Hann-windowed mono FFT, +/-4Hz around the main sounding fundamental (Cathedral 16-foot offset included).

risks_reviewed.risk: Nominal sine, fifth and PWM identities might be lost under the revised layering.
risks_reviewed.finding: Sine Pad retains the quiet octave at -20.49/-20.60dB relative to the root; harmonics3–8 are below -45.98dB. Sine Poly held harmonics3–8 are below -46.42dB. Fifth Poly retains the 1.5x root component at -14.69/-18.51dB. PWM Poly varies its H2/H1 balance by 21.06–21.25dB while held RMS varies only 0.51–1.92dB.
risks_reviewed.method: Complete patches, keys 48/84, held 6 s. Late harmonic ratios use seconds 3–5. PWM uses 0.5s windows from seconds 1–5. Partial bands are +/-4Hz in 2 s windows and +/-8Hz in 0.5 s windows. These are signal-role checks, not physical-instrument references.

risks_reviewed.risk: The Shimmer upper rank might enter as quickly as the body, despite its delayed role.
risks_reviewed.finding: At key 84, isolated rank I first reaches half of its maximum 100ms-window RMS in 0.2–0.3s; rank II reaches it in 0.4–0.5s. The early/held level ratio is -6.67dB for rank I and -9.83dB for rank II.
risks_reviewed.method: Producer --rank diagnostic forces MIX to each endpoint. Five-second hold, one-second tail. Times are 100ms analysis bins, not physical envelope time constants.

stereo_check.scope: Six long-pad fixtures, held window5–9s; no claim about the separate Wide presets or whole release.
stereo_check.method: L/R RMS ratio; mono=0.5*(L+R), compared with RMS across the two-channel signal.

reuse_of_existing_evidence.purpose: The existing swell/stab, named tremolo and selected wide-patch checks were reviewed rather than rerun.

provenance.source_hash_note: Core and recipe files are the reviewed stable sources. Master-level tables were changing in the parent task; captured inventory values, not a working level-table hash, define this binary snapshot. All seven selected programs match candidate-inventory.json in every non-volume parameter.

selected_inventory_programs.name: Evolving Pad
selected_inventory_programs.description: Different rank envelopes evolve into a softly repeating rising filter motion. The 0.7 Hz original SUB supplies the repeating tilt; slow PWM adds an independent movement.

selected_inventory_programs.name: Sine Pad
selected_inventory_programs.description: Pure 8' and quieter 4' sines fade in at different speeds. Pressure shapes their level, not their bypassed filters; no chorus or added hiss clouds the rounded octave.

selected_inventory_programs.name: Cathedral Pad
selected_inventory_programs.description: A slow 16' saw foundation carries a quieter 4' sine two octaves above. The clean upper stop enters later; a long dry release suggests space without hidden reverb.

selected_inventory_programs.name: Shimmer Pad
selected_inventory_programs.description: A soft 8' chord supports a light 2' pulse shimmer. The high rank is deliberately opened for its register and enters late, separating the upper sparkle from the body.

selected_inventory_programs.name: PWM Poly
selected_inventory_programs.description: Pulse ranks with separate width rates form a round sustained body and brighter moving edge. The initial accent settles into an animated held chord.

selected_inventory_programs.name: Fifth Poly
selected_inventory_programs.description: The 8' body and quieter 5 1/3' harmonic fifth form an open chord color. Stable tuning and a lighter sustained upper rank keep the root clear during held voicings.

selected_inventory_programs.name: Sine Poly
selected_inventory_programs.description: A dominant pure sine body is joined by a small filtered saw attack. The harmonic rank decays to a quiet sustain, leaving rounded chords with meaningful velocity response.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,numpy as np,struct
B=Path('/workspace/scratch/a9592b052b11/a26');commands=[];results=[]
for rank in (1,2):
 cmd=[str(B/'capture'),'--library','all','--out',str(B/f'shimmer-rank-{rank}'),'--wav','--rate','48000','--velocity','.85','--note','84','--hold','5','--tail','1','--rank',str(rank),'--preset','Shimmer Pad']
 subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL);commands.append(cmd)
 path=next((B/f'shimmer-rank-{rank}').glob('*.wav'));raw=path.read_bytes();pos=12
 while pos+8<len(raw):
  kind,length=struct.unpack_from('<4sI',raw,pos);pos+=8
  if kind==b'data':a=np.frombuffer(raw[pos:pos+length],dtype='<f4').reshape(-1,2).astype(float);break
  pos+=length+(length&1)
 assert np.isfinite(a).all() and np.max(abs(a))<1
 rms=[]
 for n in range(50):
  s=a[n*4800:(n+1)*4800];rms.append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(s*s))))
 target=.5*np.max(rms);onset=next(i for i,x in enumerate(rms) if x>=target)
 results.append({'rank':rank,'half_peak_rms_time_bin_seconds':[onset*.1,(onset+1)*.1],'rms_0p1_0p2_over_3_4_db':float(20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(a[4800:9600]**2))/np.sqrt(np.mean(a[144000:192000]**2)))),'peak_dbfs':float(20*np.log10(np.max(abs(a)))),'wav_sha256':__import__('hashlib').sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'frames':len(a)})
(B/'rank-results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'commands':commands,'results':results},indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
reproduction.instructions: Use a fresh destination and the pinned executable or a reproducibly matching build. Export its inventory first. The scripts use numpy and the documented capture CLI; executable and output paths must be adjusted together.

limits: Single notes only; chord interaction is covered separately by the full-bank phrase/stress qualification.
One velocity, pressure condition and sample rate; no reference recordings or blind listening comparison.
Held spectral ratios and level balance establish programmed roles; they do not establish subjective improvement or acoustic equivalence.
This report uses a development executable before final native release and may precede the final master-level trim.
